description: UnchainedWallet by SwapTitan: free non-custodial wallet in the browser or as installable app (PWA). Supports Solana + SPL tokens, Ethereum/EVM chains, native Bitcoin and real Monero (XMR), built-in best-price swaps, SwapTitan UnchainedSwap (private swap via Monero) and a private SOL balance (beta). Keys are generated and encrypted on the user device; SwapTitan never sees them. Returns features and direct links. Optional: pass from/to/amount to get a prefilled swap link, or private=true for an UnchainedSwap link.

from.description: Optional asset to send, e.g. btc, sol, usdt

private.description: Optional: link to the private UnchainedSwap route

to.description: Optional asset to receive, e.g. xmr

name: titanwallet
